coordinate_frame.origin: arbitrary layout-envelope upper-left; translate as a whole to editor coordinates

soft_envelope_mm.rationale: 532 physical refs incl 52 through-hole 5012 testpoints, two discrete TO252 bridges and 2512 shunts, LQFP100 and HPM island; starting room for review, not thermal/current sizing

shared_input.notes: DC input, protection, input bypass. CN1 left edge; orientation from actual mating mouth.

shared_bulk.notes: Bulk DC capacitors and shared ceramics; feed independent M1/M2 trunks, do not daisy-chain motor return through control.

shared_buck12.notes: U6/L6 compact switching loop; FB parts shielded from SW node.

analog_reference.notes: U12 low-noise reference distribution; keep away from buck and switching-node polygons.

logic_ldo.notes: U2 AVCC and U20 VCC; output capacitors at pins; R3 ground connection not a reason to cut a ground plane.

mcu.notes: LQFP100 including dedicated analog and digital decoupling; two crystals get local pin-based refinement.

mcu_debug.notes: Accessible J200/J201/TP200; rectangle may expand downward after actual connector bbox.

hslink.notes: USB west edge, ESD between connector and HPM. U8007 is an inductor, not IC.

display_buttons.notes: FPC bottom facing outward; three accessible buttons below/along bottom side.

m1_power.notes: Three high/low MOS phase cells, shunts, local DC capacitors, gate networks at MOS gates. Motor connector at north edge.

m1_driver.notes: FD6288, bootstraps, local 12V bypass, input pulldowns. Align driver output pads toward MOS gate cells.

m1_sense.notes: Current amplifier input/feedback clusters and voltage dividers; Kelvin paths from shunts; avoid SW copper.

m1_encoder.notes: Hall/encoder/SPI connectors, buffer, filtering, voltage-selection DNPs; outside noisy bridge.

m2_power.notes: Three high/low MOS phase cells, shunts, local DC capacitors, gate networks at MOS gates. Motor connector at north edge.

m2_driver.notes: FD6288, bootstraps, local 12V bypass, input pulldowns. Align driver output pads toward MOS gate cells.

m2_sense.notes: Current amplifier input/feedback clusters and voltage dividers; Kelvin paths from shunts; avoid SW copper.

m2_encoder.notes: Hall/encoder/SPI connectors, buffer, filtering, voltage-selection DNPs; outside noisy bridge.

packing_rules: Use authoritative imported PCB footprint bbox/courtyard, not symbol position or model body dimensions.
Place key targets first; transform functional clusters together after selecting rotation from pad/net direction.
Targets are approximate seeds. No locked refs or mandatory rotation. Expand rectangles/envelope on bbox collision; do not shrink courtyard clearance to fit.
Group rects are available regions, not full-area keepouts. Cluster children may cross adjacent group borders when electrically justified.
Preserve DNP footprints, testpoint access and original nets. All 532 refs get an explicit group; no changes to population.
Top side first for review; no forced bottom-side assignment or fixed layer stack.
Keep switched-node copper/gate loops in y<50; analog current chain at y51..61, MCU at y77..112. Separation is functional, not certified creepage.
Allow approximately 1mm placement margin outside actual courtyard as an initial collision margin only; apply project electrical/edge clearance rules separately.
No PCB edges, holes, tracks, zones or routing are requested by this JSON.
warnings: Q1 may have newer source footprint than netlist; current schematic metadata overrides netlist footprint only, nets from netlist remain source.
CN1 polarity/mating and MR30/USB/FPC exit orientation require actual pad/body check before edge placement.
Reference FOC is single-channel LQFP64, not same MCU or dimensions.
HPM U8007 is 4.7uH; U10/U1010 each four units but only one physical package.
Testpoints are large physical 5012 parts, not zero-size symbols. Do not put all power testpoints in a distant common row.
